question: Diya has to reach Surat which is 811 km away in 14 hours. His starting speed for 5 hours was 91 km/hr. For the next 84 km his speed was 84 km/hr. By what speed he must travel now so as to reach Surat in the decided time of 14 hours?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 811 km, Total time = 14 hr.

Distance covered in first 5 hr = 91 × 5 = 455 km.

Time taken for next 84 km at 84 km/hr = 1 hr.

Remaining distance = 811 − (455 + 84) = 272 km.

Remaining time = 14 − (5 + 1) = 8 hr.

Required speed = 272 ÷ 8 = 34 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 34 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance = 811 km

Total decided time = 14 hours

Speed for the first 5 hours = 91 km/hr

Speed for the next 84 km = 84 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Distance covered in first 5 hours = 91 × 5 = 455 km

⇒ Time taken to cover next 84 km = 84 ÷ 84 = 1 hour

⇒ Total distance covered so far = 455 + 84 = 539 km

⇒ Total time taken so far = 5 + 1 = 6 hours

⇒ Remaining distance = 811 − 539 = 272 km

⇒ Remaining time available = 14 − 6 = 8 hours

⇒ Required speed for the remaining journey = 272 ÷ 8 = 34 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 34 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

Average speed is the total distance traveled divided by the total time taken. Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the same direction, relative speed = |S₁ − S₂|. When moving in opposite directions, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from km/hr to m/s, multiply the value by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.
